query:
INSERT INTO twitch_streamer_identities (
                    twitch_user_id,
                    twitch_login,
                    is_on_discord,
                    created_at,
                    updated_at
                ) VALUES ($1, $2, 0, NOW(), NOW())
                ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id) DO UPDATE SET
                    twitch_login = EXCLUDED.twitch_login,
                    updated_at = NOW()
